name: Relocate for Work Support
description: Relocate for Work Support provides financial assistance to help eligible clients relocate for work, covering travel and moving expenses subject to eligibility criteria and conditions of grant.

attributes.summary: A grant to assist eligible clients with relocation costs when taking up employment that is not available locally, including travel and moving expenses, subject to eligibility and conditions.
attributes.eligibility: Receiving a main benefit or at risk of long-term benefit receipt; meeting job offer criteria including hours of employment requirements; demonstrating it is not viable to commute; being unable to get a suitable and sustainable job locally; having adequate accommodation; must cancel main benefit.
attributes.payment_details: Covers travel costs, moving possessions, with amounts varying based on number of people relocating and chosen method of travel.
attributes.obligations: Support must be used for the reason it was paid; must move within 28 calendar days; must not get a main benefit or Student Allowance after receiving grant; main benefit must remain cancelled.
